articles.title: Indian cloud firm Amagi bets on tech shift in media industry for growth
articles.mainIdea: Indian cloud firm Amagi bets on tech shift in media industry for growth
articles.summary: Reuters: Indian cloud firm Amagi bets on tech shift in media industry for growth. General Atlantic-backed Indian cloud software player Amagi Media Labs is banking ​on media customers moving to the cloud to boost ‌revenue, the company's chief executive said. Amagi aims to use ‍artificial intelligence to help media companies reduce operating costs and has prioritised investments towards developing AI-first and AI-augmented tools across its product ​lines, the CEO said. Amagi counts A+E Networks UK, Roku, Lionsgate Studios and NBCUniversal among its clients.
